test_nested_modules: test that pybind11 nested modules have correct __name__ attributes and submodule functions work
test_reference_internal: test pybind11 internal reference handling by creating objects with getter and attribute access
test_importing: test that pybind11 modules can import and expose Python stdlib types like OrderedDict
test_pydoc: test that pydoc can generate documentation for pybind11 modules and their contents
test_duplicate_registration: test that pybind11 handles duplicate registration of names without errors
